profile.name: BnOS
profile.headline: Open-source, Lightning-powered point of sale and business OS on Nostr.
profile.bio:
BnOS (Bitcoin Nostr Operating System) is an open-source, Lightning-powered point of sale and business operating system built on the Nostr protocol. It runs in the browser as a PWA, keeps data local-first, and settles payments directly to the merchant's wallet without a custodian.

Modules cover point of sale, catalog and inventory, orders and customers, reports, expenses, staff and settings. It works offline, syncs to relays you control, supports English, Lao and Thai, and is MIT licensed.

availability.note: Open source · self-host or use the hosted app

projects.title: Point of sale — Lightning checkout
projects.summary: Ring up sales in seconds with barcode, cart and instant Lightning checkout.
projects.description: The register handles barcode entry, a live cart, VAT and totals, and Lightning payment confirmation. Sales are written locally first, so a dropped connection does not stop the queue, and settle straight to the merchant's wallet without a custodian.
projects.contribution: POS flows, Lightning settlement, offline queue

projects.title: Catalog & inventory
projects.summary: Products, variants, images and live stock that update with every sale.
projects.description: A shared catalog backs the register and the shop view. Stock counts move with each sale, low-stock alerts surface in the dashboard, and products can be imported and adjusted without a central server.

projects.title: Orders, customers & reports
projects.summary: Track orders end to end, keep customer history and read sales, margins and trends in real time.
projects.description: Orders move from open to paid with a receipt and customer link. Reports cover sales, margins and trends alongside expense tracking, and the same records sync to relays the merchant controls.
